0.record: On 2 October 2023, the Council adopted resolution 2699 by 13 votes to none, with China and Russia abstaining. Ecuador and the United States submitted the draft (S/PV.9430, p. 2). Acting under Chapter VII, the Council authorized participating Member States that notify the Secretary-General to form and deploy the Multinational Security Support mission with a lead country, in coordination with Haiti (para. 1). The initial authorization lasts 12 months, with a nine-month review and financing through voluntary contributions and support (para. 1). The authorization supports Haitian police efforts to restore security and help create conditions for free and fair elections (para. 1). The Council requested a human rights compliance mechanism from participating States and called on the mission to establish oversight (paras. 10–11). It requested that mission leaders report through the Secretary-General every three months once the mission is operational on the ground (para. 18).
